ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: wind mage
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Wind Mages treat a fight like weather: something that happens to other people. Their enemies spend most of it in the air.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Throw the battlefield around. Hurl enemies through the air into walls, steal their breath and blow their bullets away.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Her teacher told her to go fly a kite. She took it very personally, and so did the raiders.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Positioning is a weapon. Gust, Hurl and Sky Toss really throw enemies: the farther they fly, the harder they land, and walls hurt most of all. Vacuum Bubble silences and suffocates, Tailwind and Wind Wall turn bullets aside, and the Cyclone sucks a whole squad in before blasting it apart. Wants Celerity and Potency.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: windblade
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Windblades learned that air moving fast enough is a sword, and that a sword moving fast enough is everywhere at once.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Become the wind with an edge. Blink from enemy to enemy, cut a hundred times a second.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Where did she go?' was the last thing most of them said. The answer was always 'behind you'.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A blinking duelist. Gale Step and Hundredfold Gale teleport you from enemy to enemy, cutting each one; Thousand Cuts shreds a single target; Eye of the Storm turns half of all attacks aside and throws some back. Wants Celerity and Potency.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: pressure sage
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Pressure Sages understand that the atmosphere weighs a great deal, and that it can be persuaded to sit on people.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Weaponise the weight of the sky. Implosions, crushing pressure and the air stolen from an entire map.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Is it me, or is it hard to breathe in here?' It is her.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Heavy control and the best answer to giant machines: Crushing Depth deals damage scaled by body size, Implosion sucks a group together and blows it apart, Dead Calm suffocates an area, and Dead Air steals the breath of every enemy on the map. Wants Potency and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: skywarden
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Skywardens stand between their friends and the guns, and the guns lose.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Guardian of the open sky. Domes of wind that eat bullets, rescues through the air, and walls of gale.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The raiders brought four hundred rounds of ammunition. They took most of it home again, in themselves.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The best protector against ranged armies. Aegis of Gales raises a dome that destroys hostile shots and throws their force back; Gale Guard does the same for one ally; Rescue lifts an ally (even a downed one) through the air to your side. Heaven's Bulwark covers a whole battle line. Wants Resilience and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bowling
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Thrown enemies hit harder, and so does whatever they land on.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: crosscurrent
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Wind spells often leave enemies off balance: worse aim, weaker swings.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: featherweight
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Bullets sometimes find only the wind where you were standing.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: high pressure
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every gust carries more weight.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: storm chaser
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Ride every storm. Cyclone and Sky Toss come back far sooner and grow larger, and you move much faster.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: eye of calm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You stand in the calm eye of your own storm. Ranged attacks lose a third of their force against you, and part of every blow is blown back at the attacker.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: tempestuous
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The wind never stops. Your wind spells often loose a free Gust at a random enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: afterimage
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: One more blink per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bladestorm
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Wind spells often leave deep, bleeding cuts.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: swarming
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Two more blades per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: untouchable
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You are rarely where the blow lands.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: edgewalker
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every kill brings your blades back sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: wind dancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You never stop moving. Gale Step returns twice as fast and blinks through two more enemies.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: honed edge
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every cut finds the gap in the armour. Huge critical chance and armour piercing.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: titanfall
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The bigger and heavier the machine, the better the sky can crush it.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: asphyxia
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Wind spells sometimes steal a breath along with everything else.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: weight of the sky
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Crushing Depth falls on a second enemy near the first.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: vacuum
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your silences last far longer, and every breath you steal for good returns mana to you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: crushing
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you do weighs more. Much more damage, and far more against machines.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: shieldbearer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every wind spell you weave leaves you a little more warded.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: guardian
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Allies near you are steadily warded while you fight.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: watchful sky
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The sky watches over you: ranged attacks lose some of their force.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: aegis
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your domes and guards come back far sooner and last half again as long.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: storm shield
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Whoever strikes you is struck back by the wind, hard. Much larger ward.

AbilityDef.label: gust
AbilityDef.description: A blade of wind that cuts and shoves its target back three cells. Anything shoved into a wall takes far more damage.

AbilityDef.label: updraft
AbilityDef.description: A column of wind pops everything in a small area into the air. They come down hard and stunned.

AbilityDef.label: hurl
AbilityDef.description: Grab an enemy with a fist of wind and hurl it ten cells. It hurts whatever it lands on, and walls hurt most of all.

AbilityDef.label: zephyr dash
AbilityDef.description: Ride a gust to the target spot. You land in a burst of wind that knocks everyone around you back.

AbilityDef.label: air lance
AbilityDef.description: Compress the air into a lance and drive it through everything in a straight line, punching through armour and shoving targets aside.

AbilityDef.label: vacuum bubble
AbilityDef.description: Pull all the air away from an enemy's head for eight seconds. It suffocates, cannot call out, and cannot cast spells.

AbilityDef.label: tailwind
AbilityDef.description: Wrap an ally in a tailwind for thirty seconds: much faster, and a third of incoming shots are blown off course.

AbilityDef.label: wind wall
AbilityDef.description: Raise a line of standing gales for thirty seconds. Bullets, arrows and shells that cross it are torn apart.

AbilityDef.label: snatch
AbilityDef.description: A cheeky gust plucks the weapon out of an enemy's hands and drops it at your feet. Mechanoids just get buffeted.

AbilityDef.label: sky toss
AbilityDef.description: Every enemy around you is thrown high into the air and slammed back into the ground.

AbilityDef.label: cyclone
AbilityDef.description: Spin up a cyclone over an area. For eight seconds it drags enemies toward its heart and batters them; then it explodes, blasting everything inside outward.

AbilityDef.label: dust devil
AbilityDef.description: Trap an enemy in its own little cyclone for seven seconds. It is thrown into the air every second and a half, and lands hard every time.

AbilityDef.label: cleansing wind
AbilityDef.description: Call a great wind across the whole map. It blows away toxic fallout and volcanic ash, clears the sky and snuffs out the fires around you.

AbilityDef.label: gale step
AbilityDef.description: Become the wind and blink through up to five enemies, appearing behind each one and cutting it. Wounds may keep bleeding.

AbilityDef.label: thousand cuts
AbilityDef.description: A storm of tiny blades descends on one enemy: twelve cuts in a heartbeat, each one hard to stop.

AbilityDef.label: razor gale
AbilityDef.description: A fan of razor wind tears through everything in front of you, shoving enemies back and leaving them bleeding.

AbilityDef.label: crosswind
AbilityDef.description: Loose eight wind blades that curve through the air and find their own targets, each one cutting and shoving.

AbilityDef.label: eye of the storm
AbilityDef.description: Stand in the calm eye of a storm of blades for twenty seconds. Half of all attacks, ranged or melee, are turned aside and part of their force thrown back. You move and strike faster.

AbilityDef.label: hundredfold gale
AbilityDef.description: Dissolve into the wind and blink between up to fifteen enemies in a few seconds, cutting each one deep. You stand in the eye of the storm when it ends.

AbilityDef.label: crushing depth
AbilityDef.description: Crush an enemy under the weight of the sky. Damage scales with body size: a centipede takes several times what a man does. It is slowed afterwards.

AbilityDef.label: eardrum burst
AbilityDef.description: A sudden spike of pressure around you bursts eardrums: enemies close by are concussed and stunned.

AbilityDef.label: implosion
AbilityDef.description: Collapse the air over an area: everything inside is sucked toward the centre, then the pressure snaps back and blasts it all outward.

AbilityDef.label: pressure lock
AbilityDef.description: Pin an enemy in place under crushing pressure for six seconds; every blow against it lands harder. Machines cannot be held down for long, but they stagger.

AbilityDef.label: dead calm
AbilityDef.description: Still the air over an area for twelve seconds. There is nothing to breathe: every enemy inside suffocates.

AbilityDef.label: dead air
AbilityDef.description: Steal the breath of every enemy on the map. They suffocate, are crushed by the weight of the sky (big ones hardest) and stagger for a moment.

AbilityDef.label: aegis of gales
AbilityDef.description: Raise a spinning dome of wind for forty seconds. Hostile shots fired into it from outside are torn apart, and half their force is thrown back at the shooter.

AbilityDef.label: rescue
AbilityDef.description: Lift an ally out of danger on a gust of wind and set them down beside you. Works on the fallen, too.

AbilityDef.label: gale guard
AbilityDef.description: Wrap an ally in a guard of wind for twenty-five seconds: most bullets are turned aside and their force thrown back. Adds a ward.

AbilityDef.label: slipstream
AbilityDef.description: Every ally around you rides your slipstream for thirty seconds: hastened, and a third of incoming shots blown aside.

AbilityDef.label: skyfall
AbilityDef.description: Leap into the sky and come down like a hammer: everything where you land is crushed and blasted outward.

AbilityDef.label: heaven's bulwark
AbilityDef.description: The sky itself stands guard. Raise a vast dome of wind for a full minute that tears apart every hostile shot fired into it and throws the whole force back at the shooter. Allies near you gain a ward and a guard of wind.

HediffDef.label: suffocating
HediffDef.description: The air has been pulled away from this creature. It can barely breathe, cannot speak, and is slowly dying.

HediffDef.label: tailwind
HediffDef.description: Wrapped in a tailwind: faster, and a third of incoming shots are blown off course.

HediffDef.label: eye of the storm
HediffDef.description: Standing in the calm eye of a storm of blades. Half of all attacks, ranged or melee, are turned aside and part of their force thrown back.

HediffDef.label: gale guard
HediffDef.description: A wall of wind turns most bullets aside and hurls their force back at the shooter.

HediffDef.label: off balance
HediffDef.description: Buffeted by the wind: hard to aim, hard to swing.

HediffDef.label: cyclone
HediffDef.description: Caught in a personal cyclone and thrown about every second and a half.

HediffDef.label: pressure-locked
HediffDef.description: Pinned in place by crushing air pressure, and the pressure makes every blow land harder.

ThingDef.label: wind wall
ThingDef.description: A standing gale. Bullets and arrows that cross it are torn apart. It blows itself out after half a minute.

ThingDef.label: aegis of gales
ThingDef.description: A spinning knot of wind at the heart of a dome. Hostile shots from outside the dome are torn apart, and half their force is thrown back at the shooter.

ThingDef.label: heaven's bulwark
ThingDef.description: The sky itself stands guard. A vast dome of wind that tears apart every hostile shot fired into it and throws the full force back at the shooter.
